identityFamily.name: Relay pixel courier
identityFamily.generationRule: Every role variant is an identity-preserving derivative of the canonical neutral asset; independent mascot redraws are not accepted.
invariants: one large orange-ringed pigeon eye and short ivory beak
blue-gray head, pale folded wings, compact dark tail and coral feet
one small left-side earpiece and one cobalt courier satchel

assets.use: Compact header, product chrome, and favicon mark
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: compact square logo sprite. Input image: canonical neutral Relay as the identity reference. Preserve Relay's exact head, eye, beak, earpiece, folded-wing proportions, plumage, satchel and parcel; tighten only the crop and pose for recognition at icon size. Hard-edged 8-bit pixel art on a genuinely transparent background. No gradients, smooth 3D shading, armor, helmet, visor, scenery, text, logo or watermark.

assets.use: Canonical identity reference and README mascot
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: canonical transparent mascot sprite. Create one compact, near-square 8-bit pigeon courier with one obvious orange-ringed pigeon eye, short ivory beak, blue-gray head, pale folded wings, compact dark tail, coral feet, a cobalt satchel containing a parcel, and one small earpiece. Mature product mascot, not a cute bird; hard-edged pixel clusters with no gradients or smooth pseudo-3D shading. No armor, helmet, visor, glowing face panel, exoskeleton, metallic chest plate, police or military styling, scenery, text, logo or watermark.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: final transparent 8-bit Courier route mascot sprite cleanup. Image 1 is the edit target route sprite and Image 2 is the canonical neutral Relay identity reference. Remove every detached opaque or semi-transparent speck. Retain only the cyan Source waypoint, canonical Relay with satchel and parcel, and orange Destination waypoint. Preserve exact compact physiology, body-to-head proportions, blue-gray head, large orange-ringed eye, short ivory beak, pale folded wing, compact dark tail, coral feet, left-side earpiece, cobalt satchel, parcel, walking pose, scale and waypoint positions. Hard-edged pixel art with alpha zero outside the three intended groups. No redraw, crop, rescale, reposition, gradients, smooth shading, background, shadow, glow, particles, text, logo or watermark.

Hard-edged 8-bit pixels; no gradient, smooth 3D shading, scenery, text, logo or watermark.
